recent_articles.title: Chamba accident: Eight tourists missing after vehicle feared fallen into gorge near Sach Pass - Himachal Pradesh News | India Today
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Eight** tourists are missing after a tourist taxi reportedly plunged into a gorge near Kalaban in Chamba district, Himachal Pradesh. The incident occurred on Friday when the group, including two children and a driver, failed to return to Dalhousie as scheduled. **Himachal Pradesh Chief Minister Sukhvinder Singh Sukhu** expressed his condolences and stated that rescue teams are facing challenges due to rugged terrain and lack of mobile network connectivity.  The state government is coordinating with local administration officials, the National Disaster Response Force (NDRF), and residents to conduct the search and rescue operation.

recent_articles.title: NDMC deploys sensor-based systems at waterlogging hotspots ahead of rains - The Tribune
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **New Delhi Municipal Council (NDMC)** has begun deploying sensor-based monitoring systems and CCTV cameras at vulnerable waterlogging points in anticipation of the monsoon season.  **NDMC Vice-Chairperson Kuljeet Singh Chahal** reviewed these measures during a field inspection, alongside senior officials from various departments. The council is working to make the area "waterlogging-free" by implementing a comprehensive Monsoon Action Plan that includes pre-monsoon preparedness, emergency response, and restoration work.  The NDMC has also initiated desilting efforts, GIS mapping of its drainage network, and coordination with other agencies to address waterlogging concerns.

recent_articles.title: Apple growers in Shopian count losses after intense hailstorm
recent_articles.rephrased_article: An intense hailstorm devastated apple orchards in Pehlipora, Dunaroo, and Zampathri villages in Shopian district of Kashmir. **Bashir Ahmad**, an apple farmer from the Gujjar community, described his damaged crops as "all my hard work ruined in a jiffy."  **MLA Shabir Ahmad Kullay** stated that farmers require hail nets at subsidized rates and a comprehensive crop insurance scheme to mitigate losses. This is the fourth hailstorm to hit the district this season, adding to anxieties among growers who fear further damage if weather conditions persist.
